questions.question: Why did you choose face recognition over RFID cards for this attendance system?
expected_points: Manual roll call loses 8 to 10 minutes per lecture
Proxy attendance is common in large classes
Avoids extra hardware for every student such as RFID cards

questions.question: Why did you use the HOG face detector instead of the CNN detector on the Raspberry Pi?
expected_points: HOG runs in real time on a Raspberry Pi 4 CPU
The CNN detector took more than 3 seconds per frame

questions.question: What caused the drop in recognition accuracy under certain conditions during your testing?
expected_points: Accuracy drops in low light conditions and near windows with backlight
Performance is affected when students wear masks or enter in a crowd
